description: Land Title Settlement  Department   -  Amendment to  the Gaz. Ex. No. 1652/63  of   07.05.2010 Homagama D/S  Division and  other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically expunging particulars of specific land parcels in various locations. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, cadastral maps, and village/division information, making it primarily about land and property matters. The content falls under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land title registrations and amendments without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
